solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Usual allowance for a US commander-in-chief

definitions.meaning: an ordinary, across-the-board award of money
Ulysses S Grant led the Union armies in the American Civil War and was known as ...

explanation.definitionFit: One sense is a phrase for a standard payment; the other is the title of the Civil War general who became president.

parts.note: a prop is something that holds a thing up

indicators.note: broadcast means scattered widely, so the letters of the word also are spread into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone offers backing and also makes it public on air.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broadcast' looks like part of the surface's radio picture, but it is the signal to scramble the next word.
explanation.definitionFit: A proposal is something put forward for acceptance, a synonym for an offer.

parts.note: a is the indefinite article
re is Latin-derived for concerning or about

explanation.surface: A short piece of writing concerning a globe.
explanation.definitionFit: A sphere of activity is a field or domain, which is an area of interest.

definitions.meaning: as an adjective the word means notable or striking
as a noun the word is a sign or motion conveying a message

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both an adjective for something remarkable and a noun for a sign made to communicate.

clue.text: A black protective coat — not right, more than anything else

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils

indicators.note: not tells us the letter for the next word is to be left out

parts.note: an overall is a loose coat worn to protect clothes

explanation.surface: Describing a dark protective coat, with the aside that it isn't the right one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not' removes R from OVERALL, leaving OVEALL.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means chiefly or most importantly, ahead of everything else.

parts.note: to couple is to join or tie together

explanation.surface: A pair of lovers sitting by the riverbank.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bank' looks like the river's edge, but here it means a row, as in a bank of seats.
explanation.definitionFit: A bank is a row of things placed one above another, which is a level or rank.

clue.text: Mistake admitted by conjuror, really taken aback

indicators.note: taken aback says the hidden letters are read backwards
the clue word that says the letters sit inside the next words

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A magician admits a slip and is genuinely startled.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters RORRE sit within 'conjuror, really', and 'taken aback' turns them round.
explanation.definitionFit: An error is a mistake, and one that has been owned up to fits the admitted slip in the surface.

parts.note: a candidate who is elected is in office
a brief is informal slang for a barrister or lawyer

explanation.surface: A barrister chosen to give the closing summary.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brief' as a barrister is British slang for the lawyer who represents you.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means briefly, or in summary, as a speaker winding up.

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the novelist's name goes round the other piece

parts.note: Henry Fielding was the English novelist who wrote Tom Jones
the answer to 19 down, a try or trial

explanation.surface: A prosecution of a writer over the matter in clue 19.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' looks like 'concerning', but here it means going round; Henry Fielding is the eighteenth-century author of Tom Jones.
explanation.definitionFit: Field-testing is trying out a product in real conditions, which is running a practical trial.

clue.text: Account for former scheme involving island

parts.note: ex is the prefix for a former partner or holder

indicators.note: involving means containing, so the scheme wraps round the next piece

parts.note: a plan is a scheme

explanation.surface: Justifying an old plan that included an island.
explanation.definitionFit: To account for something is to give reasons for it, which is to make it clear.

indicators.note: trimmed means cut short, so the last letter of the caretaker is cut off

parts.note: a verger looks after the interior of a church

explanation.surface: The church's caretaker has cut the grass edging.
explanation.definitionFit: A verge is the strip of grass along the edge of a road or path.

clue.text: State originally presented as a ritual

indicators.note: the letters of the words as a ritual are presented in a new, inventive order

explanation.surface: A nation first introduced through a ceremonial rite.
explanation.definitionFit: The country is an independent nation, a state in the sense of a sovereign polity.

clue.text: Defeat, third in series — several injured

indicators.note: third in points to the third letter of the next word
injured means damaged, so the letters of the word several are knocked out of shape

explanation.surface: A sports report: a loss, the third of the run, with several players hurt.
explanation.walkthrough: The third letter of 'series' is R; 'injured' rearranges SEVERAL into EVERSAL.
explanation.definitionFit: A reversal is a setback or loss, as in a reversal of fortune.

indicators.note: thrown back means the fish's name is turned round, read from right to left

parts.note: a dab is a small flatfish

explanation.surface: An angler returns a poor-quality catch to the water.
explanation.definitionFit: Something poor in quality, of low standard, is described this way.

parts.note: a brace is a pair, as of pheasants
to let property is to rent it out

explanation.surface: A pair rented out a group of musicians.
explanation.walkthrough: 'band' suggests musicians, but it is a ring worn on the wrist.
explanation.definitionFit: A bracelet is a decorative band or ring worn round the wrist.

definitions.meaning: a posh pronunciation of girl gives the word for a well-bred young woman; the 's stands for is
to set, like jelly, is to stiffen or firm up

explanation.definitionFit: One sense is the plummy pronunciation of girl; the other is the verb for a jelly or plan firming up.

indicators.note: during means within, so the ailing piece sits in the middle of the leave piece

parts.note: to vacate a place is to leave it
someone ailing is ill

explanation.surface: Wobbling on one's feet while off work sick.
explanation.definitionFit: To vacillate is to waver or sway, either physically or in one's decisions.

clue.text: Conservative candidate defeated by a narrower margin?

parts.note: a candidate who is defeated is the loser

explanation.surface: A Tory candidate beaten in a tighter election than before.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark admits the definition is loose: a contest won by a narrower margin was closer.
explanation.definitionFit: A tighter result or finish is described as nearer, with less separating the two sides.

indicators.note: when drunk means the letters of the word later stagger about into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone's character changes later in the evening after drink.
explanation.definitionFit: To alter is to change, here in the intransitive sense of turning into something else.

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: An invitation to sample some thin, quickly cooked steaks.
explanation.definitionFit: To try something is to put it to the trial, which is a synonym here.

parts.note: to beat is to strike

explanation.surface: It is unusual for a woman to hit out.
explanation.definitionFit: Offbeat means unconventional or eccentric, out of the ordinary.

parts.note: F is the pencil abbreviation for fine
an act is a deed

explanation.surface: A fine deed indeed, truly done.
explanation.definitionFit: A fact is something actually true, so it stands for reality.

clue.text: The Parisian, after opera, discovers how a model may be

indicators.note: after puts the French article behind the opera

parts.note: Tosca is Puccini's opera
le is the French for the, as a Parisian would say it

explanation.surface: A French person leaving the opera discovers something about a fashion model.
explanation.walkthrough: 'model' suggests a fashion model, but it is a scale model, such as a model railway.
explanation.definitionFit: A scale model reproduces the original in exact proportion, made true to its measurements.

indicators.note: taking in means admitting inside, so the family surrounds the other piece

parts.note: a clan is an extended family

explanation.surface: A family welcoming an Englishman to a fair.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fair' looks like a funfair, but it is the adjective meaning sporting.
explanation.definitionFit: A clean fight is a fair one, played within the rules.
